references.text: The same principle of impurity that is transferred to objects used by the one with a discharge, here specifically concerning the seat he sits on
A parallel law regarding women's impurity during menstruation, where everything she lies on or sits on becomes unclean
A corresponding provision about impurity from the bed and objects for a woman with a prolonged flow of blood
The basic principle that objects become unclean through contact with unclean things
A similar principle regarding impurity transferred to objects in connection with dead bodies
Haggai uses purity laws to illustrate spiritual uncleanness that spreads to what one touches
